- Android-only patch: the More button meets the required larger touch size.
- Android release validation follows current navigation and restore confirmation and retries failed SDK downloads within a bounded limit.
- Reading-data schema 4 and existing saved data remain unchanged; no migration is required. Completion history and unfinished imports retain their separate backups.
- Windows skips this patch and remains on 4.0.0. These version-matched notes do not authorize or announce a Windows update.
